subtitle: Every day you showed up
promotionalText: Now free. A heatmap of every day you showed up: calories free forever, all six metrics with one Pro unlock. Rebuilt from scratch, faster than ever.
description:
THE WALL DOESN'T LIE.

Wall of Truth turns your Apple Health data into a GitHub-style activity wall: one square per day, colored by how hard you showed up. A whole year of calories, steps, sleep and workouts on one screen. No averages to hide behind, no excuses.

FREE TO START
Calories are free forever, with every feature. When you want the full picture, unlock the other five metrics with a one-time Pro purchase. No subscription, ever.

HOW IT WORKS
Your iPhone and Apple Watch already record everything. Wall of Truth reads it straight from Apple Health and keeps your walls up to date, even in the background. Nothing to log. Ever.

SIX METRICS, SIX WALLS
• Calories Burned (free)
• Steps
• Exercise Time
• Stand Hours
• Floors Climbed
• Sleep

YOUR RANGES, YOUR COLORS
Not just done or not done. Every metric has four ranges you set yourself: Goal, Strong, Great and Peak. A short walk on a rough day still counts, and the Saturday long run earns the deepest color. Beat your top range by 50% and the day gets a gold star. Pick from 21 colors per metric.

WEEKS OR MONTHS
Read your year as one long wall, or switch to the month view and spot your patterns month by month. Tap any day for its value, and open a metric for your streaks, goal rate, daily average and best day.

WIDGETS THAT KEEP YOU HONEST
Put a wall on your Home Screen or Lock Screen, or see the last days of every metric in the overview widget. Today's empty square asks the same quiet question: are you going to fill it?

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your health data never leaves your iPhone. No account, no cloud, no analytics on your workouts, nothing to sell. The only person watching your wall is you.

———

Wall of Truth works with Apple Health (HealthKit) and is available in English, Spanish, Catalan, French, German, Italian and Polish, in light and dark mode.

Apple, Apple Health and Apple Watch are trademarks of Apple Inc. Wall of Truth is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice.
whatsNew:
Wall of Truth 2.0 is a complete rebuild.

• Free to download: calories free forever, every other metric with a one-time Pro unlock, no subscription
• A brand-new design, faster and smoother
• Month view: see your walls month by month
• Four named ranges per metric (Goal, Strong, Great, Peak) and a gold star for exceptional days
• New widgets for the Home Screen and Lock Screen, plus an overview of every metric
• Streaks, goal rate and best day for every metric
• Now in 7 languages: English, Spanish, Catalan, French, German, Italian and Polish
